section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measures administered to participants in a Portuguese-language study. The key instruments include Body Mass Index (BMI) calculated from self-reported weight and height, the Compassionate Engagement and Action Scales (CEAS) with focus on self-compassion subscales, the Acceptance and Action Questionnaire-II (AAQ-II) assessing experiential avoidance, and the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) measuring positive body image. The text references Cronbach's alphas for variables across two groups presented in Table 1, suggesting multiple sample groups were analyzed.
